independent_review.scope: The pinned README identifies the relevant Lean theorems and reports no `sorry` and no axioms beyond Mathlib. No fresh `lake build` was run for this guide.
The source uses one collision when the characteristic is not two and a separate collision in characteristic two.

members.statement: The displayed Alpöge polynomial map has Jacobian determinant equal to the constant -2.

members.statement: The three distinct rational points (0,0,-1/4), (1,-3/2,13/2), and (-1,3/2,13/2) have the common image (-1/4,0,0) under the Alpöge map.
members.title: An explicit triple collision

members.statement: The Jacobian conjecture is false in every dimension n at least 3.

members.title: A determinant-one counterexample over every field
